list.name: team
list.label: Team
list.query: SELECT COALESCE(team_alias, team_id) AS __text, team_id AS __value FROM "LiteLLM_TeamTable" WHERE blocked = false ORDER BY 1
list.rawSql: SELECT COALESCE(team_alias, team_id) AS __text, team_id AS __value FROM "LiteLLM_TeamTable" WHERE blocked = false ORDER BY 1

targets.rawSql: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(spend), 0)::float AS "Spend" FROM "LiteLLM_SpendLogs" WHERE $__timeFilter("startTime") AND team_id = ${team:sqlstring}
SELECT COUNT(*)::float AS "Requests" FROM "LiteLLM_SpendLogs" WHERE $__timeFilter("startTime") AND team_id = ${team:sqlstring}
SELECT COALESCE(AVG(spend), 0)::float AS "Average cost" FROM "LiteLLM_SpendLogs" WHERE $__timeFilter("startTime") AND team_id = ${team:sqlstring}
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(total_tokens), 0)::float AS "Tokens" FROM "LiteLLM_SpendLogs" WHERE $__timeFilter("startTime") AND team_id = ${team:sqlstring}

SELECT $__timeGroupAlias("startTime", '1d'), COALESCE(model_group, model, 'unknown') AS metric, SUM(spend)::float AS value FROM "LiteLLM_SpendLogs" WHERE $__timeFilter("startTime") AND team_id = ${team:sqlstring} GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

SELECT $__timeGroupAlias("startTime", '1d'), 'prompt' AS metric, SUM(prompt_tokens)::float AS value FROM "LiteLLM_SpendLogs" WHERE $__timeFilter("startTime") AND team_id = ${team:sqlstring} GROUP BY 1 UNION ALL SELECT $__timeGroupAlias("startTime", '1d'), 'completion' AS metric, SUM(completion_tokens)::float AS value FROM "LiteLLM_SpendLogs" WHERE $__timeFilter("startTime") AND team_id = ${team:sqlstring} GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT COALESCE(users.user_alias, logs."user", 'unassigned') AS metric, SUM(logs.spend)::float AS value FROM "LiteLLM_SpendLogs" logs LEFT JOIN "LiteLLM_UserTable" users ON users.user_id = logs."user" WHERE $__timeFilter(logs."startTime") AND logs.team_id = ${team:sqlstring} GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

SELECT COALESCE(model_group, model, 'unknown') AS metric, SUM(spend)::float AS value FROM "LiteLLM_SpendLogs" WHERE $__timeFilter("startTime") AND team_id = ${team:sqlstring} GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

SELECT "startTime" AS "Time", request_id AS "Request", COALESCE(model_group, model) AS "Model", COALESCE("user", 'unassigned') AS "User", spend AS "Spend", total_tokens AS "Tokens", status AS "Status" FROM "LiteLLM_SpendLogs" WHERE $__timeFilter("startTime") AND team_id = ${team:sqlstring} ORDER BY spend DESC LIMIT 50
